By this application under Section 438, Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 [CrPC], the petitioners viz. 1) Munna Chakraborty, 2) Kanai Lal Chakraborty, and 3) Kishor Chakraborty have approached this Court seeking the benefit of pre-arrest bail, apprehending their arrest, in connection with Badarpur Police Station Case no. 273/2022, registered under Sections 498A/307, Indian Penal Code [IPC].
3.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-3 vs The State Of Assam on 17 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: In the First Information Report [FIR], lodged on 26.11.2022, the informant has brought allegation against the three petitioners, who are the husband, the father-in-law and the brother-in-law respectively of the informant.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-3 vs The State Of Assam on 17 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: Referring to a specific incident which had allegedly occurred on 26.11.2022, the informant has alleged that on that day, all the petitioners had pressed her neck with an intention to kill her and in the process, the petitioner no. 1-husband kicked on her belly which caused bleeding from her private parts.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-3 vs The State Of Assam on 17 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: 4. The learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioner no. 1- husband of the informant had initiated a proceeding under Section 107, CrPC before the learned Additional District Magistrate, Karimganj, alleging desertion from time to time by the informant and causing harassment to the family of the petitioners and the same proceeding was initiated at an earlier point of time.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-3 vs The State Of Assam on 17 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: He has further submitted that there was no involvement of the petitioner no. 2 and the petitioner no. 3 in the alleged incident.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-3 vs The State Of Assam on 17 January, 2023.json

sentences.text:
5. List the case on 10.02.2023 for production of the concerned case diary.
6.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-3 vs The State Of Assam on 17 January, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Having regard to the allegations made in the FIR and the projections made on behalf of the petitioners, it is provided, in the interim, that in the event of arrest of the petitioner no. 2 and the petitioner no. 3 viz. Kanai Lal Chakraborty and Kishor Chakraborty in connection with Badarpur Police Station Case no. 273/2022 they shall be released on bail on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.
10,000/- each with one local surety each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the arresting authority, subject to the conditions that :
[i] the petitioner no. 2 and the petitioner no. 3 shall appear before the Investigating Officer [I.O.] of the case within 10 [ten] days from today and shall cooperate with the investigation and shall thereafter, make themselves available as Page No.# 3/3 and when their presence are required by the I.O. in the investigation of the case; [ii] the petitioner no. 2 and the petitioner no. 3 shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any witness acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the court or to any police officer;
and [iii] the petitioner no. 2 and the petitioner no. 3 shall not obstruct or hamper the police investigation and not to play mischief with the evidence collected or yet to be collected by the police.
7. Having regard to the nature of allegation made in the FIR against the petitioner no.
1- husband, the interim protection sought for, is declined at this stage.

opennyai_summary.16_August_2023__facts:
By this petition filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C., the petitioners, namely, 1. Beauty Bonia Konwar @
Beauty Konwar, Geetanjali Konwar and 3. Dharmeshwar @ Dharmendra Konwar have prayed for granting pre-arrest bail, apprehending arrest in connection with Nalbari P.S. Case No. 244/2023 u/ss 120B/420/313/498A of the IPC r/w Section 4 of the D.P.Act.
It may be mentioned that by order, dated 28.06.2023, this Court granted the privilege of interim pre-arrest bail to the petitioners.
There is no adverse report against the petitioners from the I.O.
opennyai_summary.16_August_2023__arguments: Mr. B Sarma, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor, submits that the case diary shows that the petitioners have appeared before the investigating officer and got their statements recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. as per the interim pre arrest bail granted earlier.
opennyai_summary.16_August_2023__decision:
Therefore, the interim pre-arrest bail granted vide order, dated 28.06.2023 is hereby made absolute,
subject to the following conditions- (i) That the petitioners shall co-operate in investigation as and when required;
(ii) That the petitioners shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer; and (iii) That the petitioners shall not hamper or tamper with the investigation in any manner.
Page No.# 3/3 This disposes of the anticipatory bail application.
